map.title: where i've lived
map.lede: five cities before twenty-two. each one ran differently, and i kept notes.
map.aside: evenings go to badminton or tennis, mornings to a pour-over. there is a classical guitar that gets played, a camera that gets carried, and a blue-and-white british shorthair, zai zai (崽崽), who supervises all of it.
